data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 5820 reported a net release of GBP 9.4 million in prior year claims reserves for 2014. This favorable development was primarily driven by the beneficial settlement of specific Consumer Products claims from 2010 and prior years of account, as well as a favorable run-off of Property reserves across all years of account. This contrasts with a disappointing increase in the current year's claims ratio due to attritional losses and sizeable notifications in the Political Risks book, influenced by the political and economic environment.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable settlement of specific Consumer Products claims on 2010 & prior years of account
favourable run-off of Property reserves on all years of account
disappointing increase in the claims ratio of 22.4% compared to the previous year driven by an increase in attritional losses on a number of schemes
impact of the current political and economic environment on the Political Risks book where the Syndicate has seen a number of sizeable notifications
favourable performance on 2012 and 2013 years of account
